data.headline: Walmart lifts its profit outlook after reporting $0.62 in quarterly earnings per share
data.summary: The Dow constituent reported $0.62 of GAAP earnings per share and $0.65 on an adjusted basis. Management’s raised full-year adjusted earnings outlook is $2.84 to $2.89 per share.

bull.text: Walmart reported quarterly operating income growth of 16% and a 28-basis-point expansion in its gross profit rate.

bear.text: In Dow futures, asset managers reduced their net long from 8,220 to 2,080 contracts between November 3 and 10.

watch.text: Walmart attributed the three-cent adjustment to its net loss on equity and other investments after tax. Full-year guidance uses the adjusted measure.

limitations: The Dow is price weighted and Walmart is one constituent. The older CFTC report describes Dow futures. Current DIA options exposure and the fund’s response to the release are outside this packet.
